understood.claimRestated: The Pythagorean theorem works for every triangle, and the hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle.

subClaims.text: The Pythagorean theorem works for every triangle.
subClaims.missingEvidence: A school mathematics textbook or a mathematics reference giving the statement of the theorem and its conditions.
subClaims.backgroundNote: According to the school curriculum, the theorem applies only to right triangles. General knowledge, not evidence.

subClaims.text: The hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle.
subClaims.missingEvidence: The same mathematics reference: the definition and properties of the hypotenuse.
subClaims.backgroundNote: The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle and is the longest side. General knowledge, not evidence.

caveats: The claim has two independent parts; each part is analyzed separately.
